image_description: A bright pink minibus parked on a paved street next to a modern building. The side sliding door is open, revealing two women in formal pink dresses standing at the entrance; one is inside the bus, and the other is stepping out holding a bouquet. The bus features 'My Pink Bus .com' branding with heart motifs on the side panel. A partial view of a person's hand is visible on the far left edge.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits a distinct van/minibus silhouette, significantly shorter than a city bus but with sufficient roof height for the standing passenger.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is visible, and the side profile shows window frames consistent with a passenger transport vehicle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The entrance is a large sliding door located at the mid-body section, typical for this class of vehicle.
The door mechanism is clearly a sliding type, currently retracted to allow entry/exit.
The short hood ahead of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout standard for vans/minibuses.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is outside the camera frame; only the side and front-quarter are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has a custom pink company livery with specific branding ('My Pink Bus'), which fits the 'company livery' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front wheel matches the proportions and style of a standard commercial van wheel.
The interior space visible through the open door suggests capacity consistent with a minibus (more than a car, less than a full bus).

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text is largely legible, but the font rendering has slight irregularities and softness typical of AI generation, though not completely nonsensical.

artifact_observations.location: Pink dress of the woman inside the bus
artifact_observations.reasoning: The fabric texture appears overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking fine weave details, and blends slightly into the background shadows.
The fingers gripping the bouquet stems are indistinct and appear to merge with the flowers, lacking clear anatomical definition.

artifact_observations.location: Pavement tiles near the bottom left
artifact_observations.reasoning: The grid pattern of the paving stones shows slight warping and inconsistency in line straightness near the edge of the frame.

To rigorously audit the 'My Pink Bus .com' text for character-level accuracy and artifacting.

Anatomical integrity of hands and fingers (holding bouquet, resting on door)
